name: @digitalkin/agentic-mesh-protocol
description: Node.js gRPC interfaces for Agentic Mesh Protocol - Protocol Buffer definitions for multi-agent systems

scripts.generate: npm run build:zod-plugin && npx buf generate --template buf.gen.ts.yaml && tsc -p tsconfig.gen.json
scripts.generate:reflection: npx buf build proto -o gen/descriptor.bin && npx buf build proto -o gen/descriptor.json
scripts.prepare: npm run generate && npm run generate:reflection
scripts.test:zod: npm run generate && npm run generate:reflection && npm run test:zod:fixtures && tsc -p tools/zod/test/tsconfig.consumer.json && tsc -p tools/zod/test/tsconfig.json && node --test tools/zod/test/dist/differential.test.js tools/zod/test/dist/unsupported.test.js
scripts.test:zod:fixtures: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('tools/zod/test/dist', { recursive: true })" && npx buf build tools/zod/test/fixtures -o tools/zod/test/dist/fixtures.binpb --exclude-path tools/zod/test/fixtures/unsupported && npx buf generate tools/zod/test/fixtures --template tools/zod/test/buf.gen.fixtures.yaml --exclude-path tools/zod/test/fixtures/unsupported && tsc -p tools/zod/test/tsconfig.fixtures.json
scripts.clean: rm -rf gen/ && rm -rf tools/zod/dist/ && rm -rf tools/zod/test/dist/

author: DigitalKin Inc.
